features.name: Left-to-right order
features.description: The sequence of wheel results decides the final multiplier.

review:
A fiery game where 6s on reels 1, 3 and 5 spin Wicked Wheels where they land. Blue wheels in the base game can give adding multipliers up to 100x, multiplying ones up to x10, a free spins trigger or an instant max win.

Red wheels in the bonuses go bigger, up to 500x adding. Several wheels resolve left to right, so the order of adding and multiplying matters a lot. 16,666x max – and an Epic version exists if you want even more.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
